messages:
Ava (People Ops): quick announcement — combined compliance window opens Mon 05/10. this time were asking everyone to do two quick things by 05/20: 1) finish the 10-min privacy refresher; 2) complete the short attestation form.

Ava (People Ops): teams that own controls should also upload any new or updated artifacts to /Evidence/Attest-2025. filename pattern: team_controlid_briefdesc_YYYYMMDD.pdf (e.g., data_SC-3_access-logs_20250512.pdf).

Liam (Security): note for infra logs: include a README with collection window, retention, and who has access. if youre pulling from aws cloudwatch use: 
```bash
aws logs get-log-events --log-group-name /aws/infra --log-stream-name my-stream > infra-<date>.json
```
readme next to the file please.

Zoe (Data): ill upload dataset access logs and the redaction checklist by Wed. tagging question: should i include project codes in the filename?

Ava (People Ops): include project code after the desc if helpful, yes. update the attestation tracker when you upload.

DevComplianceBot: Reminder: 1 missing attestation for Data. Deadline 05/20.

Liam (Security): if you need legal sign-off for redactions, open an "attest-ext" ticket and tag @Liam. small extensions ok but try to keep within the window.

Ava (People Ops): office hours Thu 11-12 and Fri 3-4 in #help for uploads and filename checks. bring one example filename and well confirm.

Zoe (Data): thanks — will bring samples.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: privacy refresher + attestation form + artifact uploads if you own controls. deadline 05/20 EOD. ping me with issues :)
